# zero-chip

Tag / filter chip. Text `label` with an optional leading `icon` (glyph or emoji), three variants (solid / soft / outline), five semantic colors (neutral / primary / success / warning / error) themed from theme tokens, three sizes and a `rounded` pill toggle. When `removable`, a small x is shown. Emits `on-click` when the chip is tapped and `on-remove` when the x is pressed. Built on `--uiv-*` tokens.
